name: Patch kit
blurb: Planks, oakum and pitch to stop a leak at sea.

name: Mend kit
blurb: Canvas, twine and spare line to mend torn rigging at sea.

name: Lamp oil
blurb: A can of kerosene for the running lights: a week of nights.

name: Provisions
blurb: Salt pork, hardtack, flour and coffee: a week's food for the crew.

name: Cosh
blurb: A leather sap filled with shot: puts a man down from behind without killing him.

name: Rope
blurb: A short coil of tarred line for tying a man who's out cold, so he stays out longer.

name: Bottle of whiskey
blurb: A quart of rye. A watchman or a sailor on a cold night seldom says no to a drink.
